notes.title: Our 2nd Title will be released This Weekend!
notes.notes:
Announcing the Second Installment!

In the second installment, the experience evolves further as the women have acquired powerful new magic. You will be relentlessly tormented and subjected to a variety of attacks once you are overpowered.

Additionally, after completing the game, the bonus stage offers an intense experience where you will be thoroughly humiliated in various positions.

Enhanced Features:

New Magical Powers: The women now wield powerful magic, adding a new layer of danger and excitement.

Diverse Attacks: Once overpowered, face a range of new and brutal attacks.

Bonus Stage: Experience extreme humiliation in various positions after completing the main game.

Prepare yourself for a heightened experience of horror and domination in this thrilling sequel.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2998030/_The_Feast_of_Madness__A_Night_of_Drowning_in_Forbidden_Temptation/
